scope: User-requested one-call red-body garment extraction trial

observations.keying: Saturated red body including red outlines can be removed from the exact dressed output without a second generative isolation call. The profile sleeve opening remains coherent in that generated frame.
observations.background: Displayed red/gray glow is mostly RGB in transparent pixels; alpha is used for extraction. Low alpha under 16 excluded.
observations.body_preservation: FAILED: the output moves/reinterprets the original body, with measured head/foot displacement. Direct overlay on the unchanged original creates exposed gaps and mismatched forearm/neck contours.
observations.hidden_cloth: The key gives visible clothing alpha, not intact rear cloth hidden behind exposed body. Original whole-garment source remains retained.
observations.decision: Promising extraction experiment; not a production fit or generation-ready model. No local body warping or additional generation performed.

native_acceptance: Not attempted; still behind all-generated gate
